games.name: Car Driving Simulator
games.desc:
Car Driving Simulator (CDS) is made by a solo developer which has a town, a city, an airport, a racing track and a massive highway. The car models are not made by me but they are modified and detailed by me to make them as perfect as possible. Check the help menu in the cars list for driving modes and other controls.
